title: Standard modules and Dold-Kan correspondences for generalized Reedy categories
summary: We develop a representation-theoretic approach to generalized Reedy categories through a systematic study of homomorphism spaces between standard modules. For a broad class of these categories, we provide a uniform, computable framework that reduces abstract homological constructions to elementary linear algebra and spectral graph theory via incidence matrices and morphism fibers. As a primary application, we establish a uniform extension of the Dold--Kan correspondence for categories arising from rooted trees, encompassing the categories of finite chains, finite sets and partial injections,…
